moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Data centers in space looking pretty appealing right now
moments.why: A cheeky Musk post riffing on AI energy demand as Democrats sweep midterms, spiking engagement and affecting Tesla and SpaceX stock price

moments.author: JD Vance
moments.quote: One of the things the data analysts on our side obsessed over was "composition"—whether the electorate looked close enough to 2024 for Republicans to win...
moments.why: A high-engagement, insider-style take on electoral dynamics amid midterm results that resonated widely on X

moments.author: Bernie Sanders
moments.quote: Trump asked the people to vote as if he were on the ballot. THEY DID.
moments.why: A punchy political commentary from Sanders that quickly went viral in reaction to midterm turnout

moments.author: House Democrats
moments.why: They celebrated flipping the House with a short, rallying call that spread rapidly among political audiences

moments.author: Matt Van Swol
moments.quote: Remember when the GOP gave Elon Musk a standing ovation... and NEVER passed the SAVE ACT? I don't understand the GOP...
moments.why: A biting, sarcastic takedown of GOP failings that captured political frustration and traction on X
